categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the health products sector, focusing on the design, research, production, and sales of far-infrared therapeutic saunas, portable saunas, air purifiers, and fitness equipment. It also invests in health service companies involved in remote diagnosis and health checkup projects. The business model includes self-owned brands and ODM/OEM manufacturing for domestic and international markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced production equipment and professional R&D talent to expand capacity. It emphasizes product differentiation through continuous R&D investment, upgrading manufacturing processes to improve raw material utilization and product quality. The company has obtained multiple international certifications (e.g., ETL, ROHS, REACH, CE, FCC) to facilitate global market access. It also integrates technologies such as AI, digital health platforms, and smart control systems in its products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include distributors and OEM clients across China, North America, Australia, and Southeast Asia. The company serves health-conscious consumers and institutions requiring far-infrared therapeutic saunas, portable saunas, air purifiers, and fitness equipment. Major markets are the US, Canada, and China, with a significant portion of sales generated from exports.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant international presence in the United States, Canada, Australia, and Southeast Asia. It has subsidiaries and production bases in Anhui, Shanghai, and Shenzhen, and a major sales and distribution subsidiary in California, USA. Export sales account for over 87% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the health product supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales. It sources raw materials globally, including direct procurement of wood from overseas origins to optimize supply chain stability and reduce costs. It also provides OEM/ODM manufacturing services for other brands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D investment to enhance product competitiveness, expanding product lines, and developing new health-related product categories such as steam and infrared portable saunas, ice bath machines, and red light therapy saunas. The company aims to integrate intelligent, digital, and innovative technologies into products, optimize production efficiency, and strengthen internal controls and risk management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of health products including far-infrared therapeutic saunas, portable saunas, air purifiers, and fitness equipment. The company operates via self-owned brands and OEM/ODM manufacturing contracts. Sales channels include distributors, direct sales, and OEM partnerships, with a majority of revenue from product sales to domestic and international customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the far-infrared therapeutic sauna industry with strong brand recognition and market share in the US, Canada, and China. It competes by leveraging advanced technology, product quality, and a diversified global market presence. Its financial strength and extensive certification portfolio provide competitive advantages over peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 688.8 million, a 30.1% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 46.85 million, up 76.26%. The company has a solid asset base exceeding RMB 1.3 billion and maintains a healthy cash position with strong cash flow from operations. It has demonstrated consistent growth in sales volume and production capacity across its main product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, technological innovation, and comprehensive international certifications to differentiate its offerings. Its products integrate advanced features such as AI-assisted controls and multi-functional therapy options, catering to diverse customer needs. Strong brand portfolios like Golden Designs and SAUNAKING, combined with flexible manufacturing capabilities, enhance customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
